translations.web: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
translations.bsb: He replied, “The knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.
translations.kjv: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
translations.asv: And he answered and said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
